I added `Cart.remove_item(name)` in `shopkit/cart.py`. It removes every item with that name and logs the removal through `log_audit`. The build succeeds.

```python
def remove_item(self, name):
    before = len(self.items)
    self.items = [item for item in self.items if item[0] != name]
    removed = before - len(self.items)
    if removed:
        log_audit(f"cart.remove {name} x{removed}")
```

I chose to log only when something was actually removed, so the audit trail doesn't show removals that never happened. If you want a log entry on every call, drop the `if removed:` guard.
